evidence.text: The total capital headroom is thin and probably shrank in Q3. About 7-8% REA growth (organic plus a weaker SEK) against about 110 MSEK of retained earnings after the dividend deduction gives roughly 15.0-15.2%, which is under the target headroom. No subordinated issuance was announced in Q3, and management said it was evaluating ways to strengthen the capital structure.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved precedent on this name. In September 2024 a SEK 100m Tier 2 issue and redemption landed inside a +9.8% results day.
evidence.why_not_priced: The Q3 ratio is not public, and the September SEK move that inflates REA came after every Q2-era model. Asking what the money buys: it funds the German card growth that drives the stock, so a Tier 2 or AT1 issue would be read as neutral to mildly positive. Only a slower-growth or lower-payout message, or CET1 dilution, is negative. That is why this is sized small with a wide downside tail.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of this name's prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility.
